notes: NEHALEM fixed kernels; LP64; sequential with locking; all four real/complex BLAS and CBLAS types; no LAPACK/LAPACKE, Fortran compiler or OpenMP runtime
Runtime relocation is tested with explicit-prefix include/library paths and the project probe RPATH on the observed Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 ABI.
Generated upstream CMake/pkg-config default prefix metadata is retained but not part of the relocation qualification.
Full pinned APT dependency-closure deployment is not claimed; declared gcc/make/python packages and actual runtime library identities are checked.
LAPACK/LAPACKE execution and Fortran compiler builds
Dynamic architecture dispatch, CPUs without NEHALEM ISA features, ILP64 and multithreaded/OpenMP configurations
Full upstream matrix including other architectures and optional numerical types
Official performance scores, hardware counters, OCI and cross-platform/ABI deployment

Pinned upstream CBLAS complex level-2 error-exit tests route gerc to geru via a 10-character comparison; these two missing upstream branches are reported separately. The installed project consumer independently verifies invalid-lda rejection in both cgerc and zgerc.
usage.summary: Build the fixed single-worker NEHALEM LP64 OpenBLAS/CBLAS library and retain complete upstream materials.
